Easy Turkey Pumpkin Chili
By: samantha kment
Published: Sunday, October 23, 2016 - 5:07pm

Ingredients




1 medium onion, diced
1 jalapeño, finely diced
1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
1.2 pounds 93% lean ground turkey (1 lb is fine, my turkey comes in 1.2 lb package)
2 10 ounce cans diced tomatoes with green chilies (Ro'tel)
1 cup canned pumpkin
1 15 ounce can Canelli beans, rinsed (great northern beans would work as well)
2 teaspoons garlic powder
1 teaspoon garlic salt
1 teaspoon cumin
1/2 teaspoon paprika

Preparation

1 Using a large to medium greased pan (at least 3 inches deep) begin sautéing the onion and jalapeño with the 1/4 teaspoon of salt on a low-medium heat. 2 Once they begin to soften, add ground turkey. Stir frequently until turkey is cooked through and no longer pink. 3 Add cans of diced tomatoes. 4 Stir in beans, pumpkin and spices. 5 Allow to simmer for at least 10 minutes to allow the flavors to deepen. 6 Serve with a sprinkle of fresh parmesan and a few crackers. Enjoy.

About

Warm and filling, this savory pumpkin chili is loaded with simple, wholesome ingredients and can be ready to eat in under 30 minutes.  Now that's my kind of week night meal!
